turns.prompt: when I end a meeting, the recap leaves out any task that has a person on it but no deadline. like if they say 'Priya will send the contract' with no date it just isnt in the action items. can you fix it
turns.final_message:
I fixed it, but I haven't tested it: I couldn't run a real meeting through the model here.

**Cause:** Nothing in the code throws undated tasks away. The problem was in the instructions sent to the model when a meeting ends. Neither recap prompt said to keep a task with no deadline. The Groq prompt also gave only one example, "Bob: Draft invite copy by Wednesday", which suggested that action items need a date. The other prompts in the app already had a "keep owner-only items" rule; the end-of-meeting recap never got it.

**Changes:**
- **`electron/MeetingPersistence.ts`** (the recap prompt used for the main and custom-section recaps): added a rule to keep every task that has an owner, written like "Priya: Send the contract (no date given)", and never to make up a date. The `actionItems` field description now asks for the same format.
- **`electron/llm/prompts.ts`** (`GROQ_SUMMARY_JSON_PROMPT`, the version used with Groq): added an undated example next to the "by Wednesday" one, plus a rule never to drop an item because it has no deadline.

To check it, end a meeting where someone says something like "Priya will send the contract" with no date. It should show up in the action items as "Priya: Send the contract (no date given)".

**Separate issue I noticed:** the Groq prompt asks for a `"summary"` field, but `MeetingPersistence.ts` reads `"overview"`. So with Groq, the recap's short overview at the top is probably missing. I didn't change that; I can if you want.

You were right, my first fix missed the real cause.

**What was happening:** When a meeting mode is active, the recap is built from that mode's own sections, not the generic prompt I changed last time. In the **Team Meet**, **Sales** and **Recruiting** modes, the "Action Items" section was described as *"All action items that were said **I** would do after the meeting."* So the model only kept tasks belonging to you, and "Priya will send the contract" was dropped as someone else's task.

**What I changed:**
- **`electron/MeetingPersistence.ts`**: the recap prompt for modes now has a rule that any action-item or follow-up section lists every participant's tasks, written as "Owner: task (due date)" or "Owner: task (no date given)". This rule overrides narrower section descriptions. That matters because your existing modes keep the old descriptions saved in the database, and this rule fixes them without you having to edit or recreate anything.
- **`electron/services/ModesManager.ts`**: rewrote the "Action Items" descriptions in the General, Team Meet, Sales and Recruiting templates, so newly created modes ask for everyone's tasks with owner and date.

I haven't tested this against a real meeting, and I couldn't confirm a type-check; the edits only change prompt text. Recaps that were already saved won't change. End a new meeting in the same mode with an undated "Priya will send the contract"; it should show as "Priya: Send the contract (no date given)".

**Two things to know:**
- Your existing modes still show the old "things I would do" wording in their settings. The new rule overrides it for action items, but you can update the text there if you want it to match.
- I also noticed a risk in `electron/LLMHelper.ts:574`. If the model's reply contains phrases like "I don't know" or "It depends" anywhere, the whole summary is thrown away. That could easily happen when it quotes the transcript, and the recap would then come out empty. I didn't change it; I can if you want.

I found a bug that fits your report better than the prompt wording. I've fixed it, but I haven't been able to test it.

**The bug:** the end-of-meeting summary only ever saw the **first 10,000 characters** of the meeting (`data.context.substring(0, 10000)` in `MeetingPersistence.ts`). That's roughly the first 10–15 minutes. Undated hand-offs like "Priya will send the contract" usually come in the wrap-up at the end, so the model never saw them. No prompt wording could fix that, which is why my first two changes didn't help.

**What I changed this time:**
- **`electron/MeetingPersistence.ts`**: the summary now gets the whole meeting, up to 60,000 characters. For longer meetings it keeps the start plus the full ending, so the wrap-up is never cut.
- **`electron/SessionTracker.ts`**: very long meetings (over about 1,800 transcript segments) have their oldest parts condensed into short summaries as the meeting goes on. That condensing step only kept "topics, decisions, and questions", so it now keeps every action item too, with "(no date given)" where there's no deadline.
- **`electron/llm/RecapLLM.ts`**: that condensing step also cut its output to 5 bullet points, which could still drop action items. It can now keep up to 25; the in-meeting Recap button still gets 5.

I couldn't type-check these changes because TypeScript isn't installed in this folder (`node_modules` is missing). If you run a built copy of the app, rebuild it, or the changes won't take effect.

If it still goes wrong, please send me:
1. What you see: is the task missing completely, in the wrong section, or worded badly?
2. Which mode was active, and roughly how long the meeting was.
3. If you can, the `[MeetingPersistence] Raw LLM summary response` line from the console. It shows exactly what the model returned, so I can tell whether the task is lost before or after the model.
